class Solution {
    public static int solve(Map<String, Object> data) {
        int L = ((Integer) data.get("left")).intValue();
        int R = ((Integer) data.get("right")).intValue();
        List<int[]> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (Object edge : data.get("edges")) {
            edges.add(new int[]{((Integer) edge[0]).intValue(), ((Integer) edge[1]).intValue()});
        }
        
        Arrays.sort(edges, Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
        
        int maxPairs = 0;
        int end = -1;
        
        for (int[] edge : edges) {
            if (edge[0] > end) {
                maxPairs++;
                end = edge[1];
            }
        }
        
        return maxPairs;
    }
}
